dedupe_keys.name: survey of india online maps portal and geospatial data catalogue

description: The online maps portal of the Survey of India, one of the oldest surveying institutions in the world, provides digital products and maps to citizens. Its products include the Open Series Map as free PDF, the village boundary database, the digital geographical map, geo-referenced colour raster maps, orthorectified imagery and DEM, the administrative boundary database, the digital vector database, geodetic products and services and topographical maps, with guidelines under the 2021 geospatial policy, a pricing policy and online buying steps. A data catalogue curated by the Survey of India, a 15-page PDF, lists Indian geospatial data sources with their portals, data types and whether they are public, need login or can be downloaded: SoI maps (free for government users and paid for the public) and the SoI geoportal with topographic maps, terrain maps, ground control points and DEMs, NATMO atlases, the Geological Survey of India Bhukosh portal with seismotectonic maps, the Forest Survey of India fire alert system, the DGH National Data Repository and others. Access to open series maps is free and other products are priced after sign-in; no open licence is stated. Caveats: many products are paid for non-government users. Coverage is India. It supports hazard exposure and infrastructure mapping, such as terrain and boundary data for road, rail and flood studies; related records are the Bhoonidhi ISRO data hub and ISRO MOSDAC.
